meta.measure: international overnight tourist arrivals per resident
meta.second_measure: all_visitors_per_capita adds cruise excursionists and every other sea arrival; comparable across the Pacific but not to the world ranking, which counts overnight tourists only
meta.snapshot_note: 2019 is the last pre-COVID year and the last year the World Bank series covers, so it is both the fair Pacific comparison and the only possible world ranking
meta.sources: Pacific Data Hub .Stat (SPC) DF_TOURISM_ARRIVALS, DF_OVERSEAS_VISITORS, DF_POP_PROJ; World Bank ST.INT.ARVL and population for the world ranking
